photon.scope: Live private Photon room: rendered Editor host and independent Realtime peers. Five genuine guest T1 rune answers verify the one-time +120s completion award. Tests frozen timer replication, forged peer snapshots, replay rejection, late join, live Master handoff and two-minute escape/timeout replication. Remaining nine topics and shortened timeout are explicitly Admin/clock fixtures. Remote rendered UI and Android devices are unverified.
